title: Records made with Prima
summary: A short exchange about the Prima records, one now reissued as a bootleg with Brunis as leader.

blocks.x: Did you make records with Prima from other students?
Yeah, we made, yeah. In fact, they just released one where I was a side man. Now I'm the leader and Prima's a side man. The same record. It's bootleg.
Oh, I saw that thing. Yeah.
Yeah, on some of that, the cheek labels.
